If a BSW mod- ule or a SWC uses a library, the developer should add an ImplementationDependency- OnArtifact in the BSW/SWC template. minVersion and maxVersion parameters corre- spond to the supplier version. In case of an AUTOSAR library, these parameters may be left empty because a SWC or BSW module may rely on a library behavior, not on a supplier implementation.
